example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাছে চোদ্দবুড়ি গল্প আছে বলে।
example_sentences_in_english: A whole lot of people came to the fair.
He has loads of stories to tell.
history: The idiom originates from the imagery of numerous knots (গাঁট) in cloth supposedly tied by fourteen old women, symbolizing a large quantity or excess.
note: Often used in everyday speech to exaggerate numbers.
